messages.en: What are you doing~~?
I'm currently fighting with my charger.
Why does it keep stopping halfway through charging?
Also, during 'Sad Girl'...
My part...
It came out weaker than I expected.
I'll make sure to do it properly.
I've got a lot to prepare for tomorrow.
First, I'll make sure I'm fully prepared for everything...
I heard the Sad Girl outfit is a hot girl concept. I'm excited.
It's such a hot girl vibe.
I can't even eat.
You're definitely going to eat though.
Yeah.
Today, Chaeyeon unnie kept saying...
That she became a fan of me.
She said she wants to become a member of the Hexagon.
She likes me so much~

messages.ko: 나의 최애였던 언니가 이젠 나의 팬?
messages.en: My former favorite person is now my fan?
Sounds like the title of a web novel.
ㅋㄹㅋㅎㅎㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋ
What should I eat at the salon this time~?
I'm heading back to the salon soon.
Yukhoe sounds good.

messages.ko: 음방 끝나면 마라탕에 치킨에 라면에 야채곱창에 닭발에 진짬뽕에 찜닭에 간장게장까지 야무지게 먹어야징
messages.en: After music shows are over, I'm going to properly eat malatang, chicken, ramen, veggie tripe, chicken feet, Jin Jjamppong, jjimdak, and soy sauce marinated crab.
Are you eating all of that in one day????
Of course!!!
Can't you eat like that even now...? (I'm genuinely curious.)
Then during the music show, you wouldn't see me—you'd just see a pig standing there.
Right now, I've gained just the right amount of weight.
If I lose a little more, I'll look prettier. If I gain more, it'll be a disaster.
I'm right on that borderline.
Wow, I'm already excited just thinking about eating yukhoe.
My heart is beating with excitement.
Wav,
Please take care of your throats just as much as tripleS does.
At the music show...
There was someone in the front row.
They were gripping a sheet of paper tightly.
And singing with all their strength.
I got really worried.
I wondered if their throat was okay.
The throat candy we gave as a reverse fan gift was a good idea.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎ

messages.ko: 응원법 빡세게 만들어놓고 열심히 부르라고 목캔디 주는 아이돌이 있다
messages.en: There's an idol who makes a difficult fan chant, tells fans to sing it loudly, then gives them throat candy.
Anyway, let's do our best again tomorrow.
I should get at least a little sleep.
You worked hard today too~
Haranghae 🥹❤️
